Markets.title: Market wrap:  M&M, Axis Bank, Asian Paints, Infosys top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Tuesday
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets extended their losses to a sixth consecutive session on Tuesday, driven down by geopolitical tensions and high crude oil prices. The Nifty fell 0.55% and the Sensex dropped 0.63%, with IT, PSU bank, and realty sectors leading the decline.

Markets.title: Jefferies raises Belrise Industries target price, sees 18% upside on strong demand, business expansion
Markets.summary: Jefferies maintained its buy rating on Belrise Industries and raised its target price to Rs 280. The brokerage cited strong demand and business expansion as drivers for robust earnings growth, despite risks from customer concentration and margins.

Markets.title: Rupee ends marginally lower as central bank shields from oil, yield strain
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee fell slightly on Tuesday due to high oil prices and rising global bond yields, despite suspected intervention by the Reserve Bank of India. Additionally, Indian government bonds saw rising yields alongside a minor decline in local stock markets.

Markets.title: Defence stocks fire up! Paras Defence, GRSE, other stocks jump up to 10% as govt notifies 6th indigenisation list
Markets.summary: Indian defence stocks surged up to 10% after the government released its sixth Positive Indigenisation List. The new list includes 405 items with a business potential of Rs 3,070 crore to boost domestic manufacturing and reduce imports.

Markets.title: Bitcoin climbs towards $64,000 as cooling inflation and falling treasury yields aid recovery
Markets.summary: Bitcoin neared $64,000 due to cooling inflation, lower Treasury yields, and reduced expectations of US monetary tightening. Although other cryptocurrencies also gained, analysts warn that the recovery remains fragile ahead of upcoming economic data.

Markets.title: Following smart money: Where are India’s top investors betting next?
Markets.summary: India's family offices and institutional investors are shifting toward private credit, venture debt, and co-investments. They are making these moves to diversify their portfolios and find new sources of higher returns.

Geo-Political.title: Russia warns UK will pay for supplying drones to Ukraine
Geo-Political.summary: Russia accused the UK of escalating the war in Ukraine after British-made drones were used in attacks against Russian targets. The UK Ministry of Defense defended its actions, stating it remains committed to standing against Russian aggression.

Geo-Political.title: IVF staff accused of misleading UK parents about sperm and egg donors in northern Cyprus
Geo-Political.summary: Staff at an IVF clinic in northern Cyprus are accused of misleading UK parents by using unselected sperm and egg donors. Multiple children are feared to have been conceived using these wrong donors.

Geo-Political.title: Tupac murder trial: 'All hell broke loose' night of rapper's shooting, witness says
Geo-Political.summary: A testifying police officer stated that Tupac Shakur refused to cooperate after being shot multiple times. Shakur instead told the officer that he and his associates would handle the situation themselves.

Geo-Political.title: Inside secret police warehouse as Germany targets small boats gangs
Geo-Political.summary: German authorities seized dinghies and life jackets from a secret police warehouse during their first raids targeting small boat smuggling gangs. The operation marks the initial enforcement of a new law designed to crack down on human trafficking networks.

Geo-Political.title: China censors public mourning as it holds former premier's funeral
Geo-Political.summary: China is strictly censoring public mourning during the funeral of former premier Zhu Rongji. Authorities are suppressing this nostalgia out of concern that it could spark criticism of President Xi Jinping's administration.

Geo-Political.title: Student killed in Philippines Catholic school shooting
Geo-Political.summary: A student was killed in a shooting at a Catholic school in the Philippines. The alleged shooter, who was also a student, subsequently died by suicide.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author recently discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top organic result for a related query. This unexpected recommendation occurred without the use of paid advertising.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools designed to help digital creators stay ahead in 2025. These tools are revolutionizing the content creation process and making it easier for creators to manage their work.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is a generative AI platform that enables users to create various types of AI content. In addition to content creation, the platform provides tools for creators to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: Govt frontloads farm spending as El Nino risks cloud rural outlook
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has accelerated its agricultural spending and fertilizer subsidies to protect rural incomes from El Nino and a weak monsoon. This increased financial support aims to cushion rural consumption against weather-related risks.

Data & Insights.title: $57 billion pours in, another $30 billion may follow: Indian economy eyes massive $50 billion surplus
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research projects a $50 billion surplus in India's balance of payments for the 2027 fiscal year. This financial milestone is expected to be driven by strong foreign currency inflows.

Data & Insights.title: Patchy progress, masked extremes: how the Southwest Monsoon has played out so far
Data & Insights.summary: Although the Southwest Monsoon's overall cumulative rainfall deficit has narrowed to 13%, the season is marked by severe regional imbalances. Erratic weather patterns are causing dangerous swings between intense deluges and prolonged dry spells across different areas.

Data & Insights.title: Govt weighs scrapping performance bank guarantees for MSME contracts
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is considering the removal of performance bank guarantees for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) receiving government contracts. This change is significant because MSMEs accounted for half of the central government's ₹2.30 trillion procurement in FY26.

Data & Insights.title: India’s overall unemployment rate falls in July; joblessness rises in urban centres but eases in rural areas
Data & Insights.summary: India's overall unemployment rate decreased in July according to the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS). While joblessness increased in urban areas, it declined in rural regions.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Indian consumers are spending again. Can it last?
Data & Insights.summary: Indian consumer spending grew in the first quarter, driven by rural demand, premium products, and quick commerce. However, higher input costs and food inflation threaten to derail this ongoing recovery.

India.title: He Delivered Bihar, Now BJP Bets On Vinod Tawde For Uttar Pradesh Hat-Trick
India.summary: The BJP has appointed Vinod Tawde as the party's in-charge for Uttar Pradesh. This decision follows his successful organizational strategy and role as state in-charge in Bihar.

India.title: 405 Items Worth Rs 3,000-Crore In Defence Ministry's 'Made In India' Push
India.summary: The Defence Ministry added 405 items worth Rs 3,000 crore to its "Made in India" procurement list to boost domestic manufacturing. This list comprises 389 items for defence public sector undertakings and 16 items for the Indian Coast Guard.

India.title: Top Cop In Bihar's Siwan Removed After AK-47 Used During July Student Protests
India.summary: The top police official in Bihar's Siwan district was removed following the use of an AK-47 during student protests in July. Although the constable who fired the weapon was previously suspended, the officers in charge at the time have not yet received new assignments.

India.title: Breakthrough At IIT Bombay: Low Cost Catalyst Promises Cheaper, Greener Hydrogen
India.summary: Researchers at IIT Bombay have developed a low-cost catalyst using earth-abundant materials. This breakthrough aims to make hydrogen production cheaper and more environmentally sustainable.

India.title: Opinion: Opinion | Mumbai's 'Marathi' Test For Cabbies, And The Art Of Fixing The Wrong Problems
India.summary: A new rule in Mumbai requires taxi drivers to know the Marathi language. The opinion piece questions the necessity of this mandate since the city's transport system has functioned well without it for years.

India.title: "Book Mahatma Gandhi Too": Congress Chief On Complaint Over Vande Mataram Row
India.summary: A complaint was filed against Congress leaders Sonia Gandhi and Rahul Gandhi for allegedly disrupting the singing of Vande Mataram at party headquarters. In response, Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge sarcastically suggested that Mahatma Gandhi should also be booked.

General.title: Russia warns UK will pay for supplying drones to Ukraine
General.summary: Russia warned the UK that it will face consequences for supplying drones used by Ukraine in recent strikes. The UK Ministry of Defense responded by stating it remains committed to opposing Russian aggression.

General.title: British couple on honeymoon killed in helicopter crash on Greek island
General.summary: A British couple on their honeymoon was killed along with their Greek pilot in a helicopter crash on a Greek island. The newlyweds were identified as Alexander Cromie and Marie Ebert.

General.title: Man charged with sharing asylum seeker addresses
General.summary: A 62-year-old man has been charged with sharing the addresses of asylum seekers. He is currently remanded in custody and is scheduled to appear at Norwich Crown Court on September 14.
